headline: Goldman Sachs: AI Could Displace One in 11 Jobs, but Major Cuts Likely Await Downturn
summary: A Goldman Sachs analysis by Joseph Briggs estimates AI could displace one in 11 workers, noting companies historically delay automation-related layoffs until economic downturns occur.
why: Workforce restructuring driven by automation impacts labor productivity, aggregate demand, and corporate profit margins.

impacts.name: Information Technology
impacts.why: Adoption of enterprise AI tools increases long-term software vendor demand and operational leverage.
